acceptanceCriteria: A decision records whether an ACP proxy replaces, complements or is rejected against the ranked per-editor rows.
If accepted, a spec lists the extracted fields, the forwarding guarantee and a hostile-message corpus before any code.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner's request to research Corvint integrations with large productivity gains. ACP is the open JSON-RPC editor-to-agent protocol started by Zed with JetBrains; Zed and JetBrains support it natively and Neovim and Emacs through community plugins (agentclientprotocol.com). A per-session stdio proxy between editor and any ACP agent could inject a context packet at prompt time and capture edits for the CEM, covering EXTENSION-ECOSYSTEM ranks 8, 10 and 13 with one adapter. Constraints: per-session process only (invariant 7, no permanent daemon); the proxy sees full prompts and trajectories, so it must forward bytes and extract only the minimum fields, like the DeepSeek Harness privacy stance. Related: V1-0201 (JetBrains over corvint-mcp). Any productivity gain is a hypothesis until measured; `corvint surprise` and `corvint necessity` supply the measure.
title: hosts: evaluate an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) pass-through proxy as one companion surface for Zed, JetBrains, Neovim and Emacs
